summary: This presentation outlines the history and mission of the Sephardic Community Alliance, focusing on its efforts to support youth and address contemporary ideological challenges. It features a detailed overview of the organization's programs, a speech by Hacham Shimon Hal Alouf, and closing remarks by Morris Bailey regarding the importance of community unity.
